description: Claude Code plugins that teach an agent to use stock WordPress as the substrate for a specific real-world job

plugins.name: healthypress
plugins.description: Run a private WordPress.com site as a personal health record: creates a dedicated privacy-hardened site with a closed health taxonomy, then records each event as a private, dated, tagged post. Records and organizes; never diagnoses or advises.
